title: PLAT-103 extra: apps/sub-route-reports also calls validateApp; pass owner (insights)

summary: PLAT-103 shipped in PR #1 (mono, merged to main as 2c5e93d; CI and CD green). Changes: validateApp in libs/shared-contracts throws when owner is missing or blank, and the package moves to 2.0.0 (breaking). core-shell passes owner 'platform', billing passes 'payments', and reports passes 'insights' (the team fields in each package.json). Assumptions: (1) sub-route-reports also calls validateApp and would fail at startup, so I added it as an extra sub-task. (2) Shared-contracts is inlined at build time and never published, so no registry release is needed. The apps shipping is the release, and the 2.0.0 bump is only a semver signal. (3) Owner values are hardcoded to match each package.json team field, since the bundler cannot read JSON. (4) All PLAT-103 sub-tasks went into one PR, because the contract change would break any app that had not been updated. (5) Whitespace-only owners are rejected as well as empty ones.
